_comment: TEST-ONLY well-known keys baked into the world-contracts snapshot image. These private keys are PUBLIC and committed on purpose so downstream builders/services can act on the pre-deployed contracts. NEVER use these accounts on a real/public network or fund them with real assets

governor.role: Deploys the contracts and owns the GovernorCap.

admin.role: Owns the builder AdminCap, registered as server address, and is an admin in the AdminACL.

sponsor.role: Sponsor with lots of SUI (coin balance + address balance)

player.role: Player A (PLAYER_A) that owns a character on the baked chain.

player_b.role: Player B (PLAYER_B) for second-player integration and builder extension scripts.

exchange.role: Holds the baked EVE token balance (10M EVE) for exchange / economy integration tests.
